walls.notes: Lion Yard (1970s, refaced c.2008) Petty Cury frontage. Geograph 7373033/3910870/6025074: ground-floor shop units recessed behind a colonnade of white-painted concrete piers on red granite plinths (~6 m centres), white concrete fascia band at first-floor level, upper storey in orange-buff brick with projecting dark-bronze framed box windows; hanging blade signs. Pier and bay positions approximate; recessed shopfronts modelled on the wall plane.

Low (≈3 m) Lion Yard segment along Petty Cury: white-painted concrete colonnade/canopy edge of the shopping-centre frontage (see geograph 3910870). Only the white piers are modelled; ~6 m spacing assumed.
1970s Lion Yard: buff brick, white concrete piers/slab edges, recessed ground-floor arcade; 2 m return with no openings.

Lion Yard west flank on Guildhall Place (the passage between the Guildhall and Lion Yard). No openly licensed photo of this face found; material and treatment copied from the Petty Cury frontage of the same 1970s building (:44/:48: orange-buff brick, white concrete band and piers at ~6 m). Left blank (no windows) instead of the default procedural layout, which invents a 2.8 m window grid.
